title: A more polished everyday experience
summary: Accumulated application and platform improvements reached production, with a focus on interface polish and stability.
benefit: Routine improvements help make day-to-day work in Mach 1 smoother and more reliable.

highlights.title: Application updates in production
highlights.description: The latest web application updates include interface improvements and stability refinements.
highlights.benefit: A more polished experience for the tasks your team already performs.

foundation: A core platform production release brought accumulated backend enhancements and reliability refinements into the live product.

title: Keep history without slowing down daily work
summary: Long-term cloud archiving helps Mach 1 store historical account data efficiently as your account grows.
benefit: Your team's growing history puts less pressure on the everyday operations you rely on.

highlights.title: Long-term data archiving
highlights.description: Secure cloud archiving stores historical account information efficiently, helping maintain responsive daily platform operations.
highlights.benefit: Keep historical information while supporting a responsive working experience.

highlights.title: Application refinements
highlights.description: Scheduled application updates brought performance polish and interface refinements.
highlights.benefit: Small improvements make working across the application smoother.

foundation: Routine database optimizations and platform maintenance strengthen backend reliability.
Foundational application work prepares the platform for future customer features.

title: Understand your estimated AI usage costs
summary: Administrators can see estimated AI usage costs by model, review an aggregate total, and include cost insights in CSV exports.
benefit: Give budget conversations a clearer starting point with model-level estimates your team can review and export.

highlights.title: Estimated costs by model
highlights.description: The admin usage dashboard now breaks estimated AI usage costs down by model and shows an aggregate total. These figures are estimates, not invoices.
highlights.benefit: Understand which models contribute to estimated usage costs without piecing together separate reports.

highlights.title: Exportable cost insights
highlights.description: Include estimated AI cost information in downloadable CSV reports.
highlights.benefit: Bring the same usage estimates into your existing budget tracking and review process.

foundation: Updated database connection components improve reliability and help prevent temporary data access interruptions.
A production release brought accumulated platform enhancements and stability improvements to users.

title: Get to work faster, keep your place
summary: Faster initial loading, clearer Tower feedback, and more reliable automation help teams stay focused on their work.
benefit: Spend less time waiting to get started and keep your workflow view as you move through the app.

highlights.title: A lighter first load
highlights.description: Tower loads when you open or interact with it, reducing the work needed when the application first starts.
highlights.benefit: Get into the application faster while keeping your assistant available when needed.

highlights.title: Clear progress, preserved views
highlights.description: Tower shows loading progress when opening and preserves your view state as you navigate between screens.
highlights.benefit: Know what is happening and return to the view you were using.

highlights.title: Agents connected to their workflows
highlights.description: Agents automatically connect to and execute their designated workflows.
highlights.benefit: Keep agent execution aligned with the workflows assigned to it.

fixes: Fixed an issue that prevented Tower from launching smoothly.
Improved the reliability of scheduled background tasks.
foundation: Regular backend and agent-engine production updates delivered operational and foundational improvements.

title: Agent runs that respect your rules
summary: Custom timeout limits and evaluation criteria are actively enforced during agent execution.
benefit: Keep automated tasks within the limits and expectations your team has configured.

highlights.title: Enforced timeout limits
highlights.description: Automated agent tasks respect configured timeout limits during execution.
highlights.benefit: Prevent runs from continuing indefinitely when a time limit has been set.

highlights.title: Evaluation settings that apply to runs
highlights.description: Agent execution actively respects configured evaluation criteria.
highlights.benefit: Make automated execution more predictable and consistent with your team's preferences.

title: Faster search and immediate workflow control
summary: Search recovers from dropped connections, active workflows stop immediately, and integration diagnostics provide clearer feedback.
benefit: Find information with fewer interruptions and take control when a workflow needs to stop.

highlights.title: Faster, more resilient AI search
highlights.description: Updated database connection handling improves search response times and automatically recovers from connection drops.
highlights.benefit: Keep looking up information with fewer interruptions from temporary connection problems.

highlights.title: Immediate workflow cancellation
highlights.description: Stop active workflows immediately without waiting on stuck execution states.
highlights.benefit: Regain control promptly when a run is no longer needed.

highlights.title: Clearer integration diagnostics
highlights.description: When an integration returns no available actions, Mach 1 explains why and redacts sensitive credentials from the diagnostic feedback.
highlights.benefit: Troubleshoot missing actions with useful information while protecting credentials.

fixes: Fixed automated security lookups where unrelated system files interfered with scans, restoring accurate email lookups.
foundation: Production deployments and aligned release branches streamline future updates.
Agent release infrastructure was synchronized for more consistent builds.

title: Bring workflow-powered chat to your website
summary: Embeddable workflow chat, self-service widget management, and simpler agent setup make it easier to put Mach 1 to work.
benefit: Let administrators manage website chat and troubleshoot connections without waiting for an engineering deployment.

highlights.title: Embeddable workflow chat
highlights.description: Add a public chat experience powered by Mach 1 workflows to your website.
highlights.benefit: Make your workflows available through a chat experience where visitors already are.

highlights.title: Self-service widget management
highlights.description: Administrators can create, edit, enable, disable, and install public widgets from the Chat Widgets settings page, with protected security credentials.
highlights.benefit: Manage website chat from one settings page without an engineering deployment for each change.

highlights.title: Drag-and-drop image uploads
highlights.description: Drag multiple images directly into the agent setup interface.
highlights.benefit: Add images during setup with fewer individual upload steps.

highlights.title: On-demand connection checks
highlights.description: Test external tool connections and see active connections or detailed feedback when a check fails.
highlights.benefit: Identify connection problems while setting up an integration.

foundation: Agent execution gained development and production environment controls.
Legacy API route cleanup and routine agent production updates support maintainability and reliability.

title: More model choice, clearer operations
summary: OpenRouter expands AI model options, updated defaults reach workflow tools, and usage views become faster and clearer.
benefit: Choose from a broader range of models and spend less time checking the status of your operations.

highlights.title: Broader AI model selection
highlights.description: OpenRouter model options are available in the application, with routing support across key evaluation tools, including models such as GPT-5.4 mini.
highlights.benefit: Give your team more flexibility in selecting models for supported tasks.

highlights.title: Updated default models
highlights.description: Default models moved to Gemini 3.6 Flash across workflow chat, schedule generation, bot configurations, and background systems. Settings pointing to older default versions are updated automatically.
highlights.benefit: Keep supported workflows on the updated default without manually changing each older setting.

highlights.title: Faster usage summaries
highlights.description: Optimized backend lookups speed up execution summary loading for active accounts.
highlights.benefit: Review activity with less waiting for usage information to load.

highlights.title: Clearer active execution views
highlights.description: Paused tasks are filtered out of active execution views.
highlights.benefit: Help support and operations teams focus on work that is currently active.

fixes: Fixed failed cancellation of stuck or stale workflow executions so users can clear those runs reliably.
foundation: Unused database tables and system routes were removed to improve maintainability.
Regular frontend and Pi agent-engine updates keep platform components synchronized.

title: Keep Tower close and team knowledge organized
summary: A persistent Tower sidebar keeps assistant sessions in reach, while shared context and secret controls support work across teams.
benefit: Keep your place with your assistant and give teams more control over the information and credentials they share.

highlights.title: A persistent, resizable Tower
highlights.description: Tower lives in a resizable right sidebar. Active assistant sessions persist as you navigate, close and reopen panels, or refresh the browser.
highlights.benefit: Move between tasks without losing your assistant session.

highlights.title: Organization and department context
highlights.description: Share and manage context at organization and department levels, and move information between scopes by promoting or demoting it.
highlights.benefit: Organize shared knowledge around the teams that need it.

highlights.title: Shared secret controls
highlights.description: Manage secrets at organization and department levels with granular grant controls and clear safety warnings.
highlights.benefit: Give teams explicit controls over access to shared sensitive credentials.

foundation: Database updates support workflow settings, shared secrets, and organization-wide context while optimizing queries.
Accumulated application updates and underlying provider maintenance improve the platform foundation.
